alt: The Settings sidebar as a member (not the owner) whose role has Organization Settings View sees it: Settings, Brands, Users, Billing and Affiliate Portal, with no Roles item
_source: Local EF app (EF_APP=http://127.0.0.1:8010), demo organization 798. The capture signs in as the demo owner, then the eval action swaps window.user for a fictional member (Priya Shah, role finance, permissions organization.settings.view + organization.members.view) and calls the sidebar's own buildSidebar(), so the real menu logic in SettingsApp.vue decides what shows. The crop is the menu only (the footer still holds the owner's name). Re-shoot: EF_APP=<local app> node tools/shots/shoot.cjs organization-settings-sidebar-billing

actions.eval: (() => { Object.assign(window.user, { id: 9103, name: 'Priya Shah', email: 'priya@example.com', organization_role: 'finance', role: 'finance', permissions: ['organization.settings.view', 'organization.members.view'], metrics: ['revenue', 'sales', 'aov'] }); const link = [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(a => a.textContent.trim() === 'Affiliate Portal'); let c = link && link.__vueParentComponent; while (c && !(c.proxy && typeof c.proxy.buildSidebar === 'function')) c = c.parent; if (!c) throw new Error('SettingsApp not found'); c.proxy.buildSidebar(); })()

annotations.title: No Roles
annotations.text: Roles shows under Users for the owner only
